environment.browser: Chrome (Playwright channel=chrome) HeadlessChrome/153.0.0.0, persistent profile, fresh per run
environment.audio_encoder: Opus (no AAC encoder in this Chromium)

substituted_components: failures injected by monkeypatching IDBObjectStore.prototype.put (manifest write throws QuotaExceededError) and by directly flipping/deleting stored blob rows; not real quota exhaustion or real disk corruption
expected: Every injected storage failure yields a stable error code or an explicit warning and preserves the last good revision; damage stays inside its workspace; a tampered backup writes nothing.

cases.detail: Last render was not restored (MISSING_ASSET: Rendered MP4 is missing from storage); the next render will be a full render.

comparison_semantics: Each case records expected vs observed code and re-loads the project to check revision/planHash.
claim_supported: In real Chrome IndexedDB, a failed save mid-transaction leaves the previous revision loadable; stale writers get REVISION_CONFLICT; an evicted render cache degrades to a warning; corrupted or missing pinned voice takes are refused (CORRUPT_ASSET/MISSING_ASSET) rather than re-synthesized; damage in one workspace does not reach another; a tampered bundle is rejected with nothing written.
claim_not_supported: real quota exhaustion or browser-initiated eviction
crash/kill of the browser process mid-transaction (abort path only)
